utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. Do you still need any tools or extra hands?

utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Bo—basic tools, screws, nails, and any spare tarps or duct tape would help most. If you can drop them off sometime this week, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Opal—thank you. A quick list of covered addresses and drop-off spots would really help us keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Bring whatever tools you’ve got handy—hammer, screwdriver, and maybe a wrench set if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so the repair drive is still on, right? Just confirming before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s still on — we’re all set for the repair drive. Come by whenever you can, and bring those tools if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s wonderful—looks like the neighborhood is really coming together. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along any more updates.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Tess — I really appreciate you keeping an ear out. I’ll make sure the broken lamps are over by your porch by 5.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — I’ll watch for them by my porch at 5. Thanks, Jules; I’m glad to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — so it’s this Saturday morning at the community center, and the focus is small home repairs like leaky faucets, loose cabinets, and broken shelves?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, that’s right — Saturday morning at the community center for small home repairs like those. I’ll keep spreading the word around the block and try to bring a few more neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—just let me know the exact dates as soon as you have them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details, but I’m glad it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — I’m late again, but I can still help. I’ve got a hammer and screwdriver for sure, and I’ll check for the wrench set before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s still the plan — this Saturday morning at the community center, with small repairs like leaky faucets, loose cabinets, and broken shelves.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—I'll keep spreading the word. We’re meeting Saturday at 10 by the community center, and folks can bring any tools and gloves if they have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — 10 a.m. at the community center works. I’ll keep that in mind and share it with the other parents around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — could you come by around 10 and bring the drill and wrench set? Send me the volunteers’ names when you have them, and I’ll get the sign-out list ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Anytime after 3 should be fine. I’ll be here.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Uli — after 3 works, and I’ll be there with the sign-out list. Just send the volunteers’ names when you can, and I’ll get everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 6:30 works for me. I’ll bring the screwdriver and gloves and be ready when you swing by.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, 6:30 it is — I’ll swing by then. Thanks for bringing the screwdriver and gloves; that’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I’ll be ready at 6:30.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can keep spreading the word about tools and nails, and I’ll ask around for anyone who can help sort the donations too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Nell — that helps a lot. I’ll send over the repair drive details and the school times next.

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — the quick version is we’re gathering repair supplies this week, and I’ll let you know the exact time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — just give me a shout when you’ve got the time set, and I’ll bring the drill and wrench set.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
